    .card_guides {

      margin-bottom: 0;

    }

      top: 0;

      height: 100%;
      font-size: 0;
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: inherit;
    }

      z-index: 1;
      border: 0;
      background: none;
      font-family: inherit;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--kontur-grayscale-54-secondary-text);

      transition: .15s ease;
    }
    
    .copy-clipboard:hover {

    .version {
